paite: Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Huang sungnungzaw pen kongpi suahlam nga pen nasep ni, ni guk sung a kikhak ding a, Sabbath leh kha thak ni in akihong ding ahi.
heading: Sabbath

paite: Huan vaihawmpa bel kongpi sumtawng ah alut ding a, kongpi baangka chin ah adingh ding a, siampute'n ahalmang kithoih leh lemna thillatte abawlsak ding ua, lutna kongpi dantan ah Pathian abe ding; huchi in apawtkhe ding a, nitaklam tan kong khak louh ahih ding ahi.
Huan vantang in bel Sabbath leh kha thakte ah kongpi lutna chinte ah TOUPA ma ah Pathian abe ding uhi.
Sabbath ni in vaihawmpa'n TOUPA kiang a halmang kithoihna a lat ding bel belamnou gensiatbei guk leh belamtal gensiatbei khat ahi ding.
Belamtal khat zel ah tanghou lat ephah khat, belamnou pen ah bel apiak theih bangbang leh ephah khat ah sathau hin khat zel ahi ding hi.
Kha thak ni in ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai gensiatbei khat, belamnou guk leh belamtal khat ahi ding a, gensiatbei ahih vek ding uh ahi.
heading: Kha Thak

paite: Huan tanghou lat abawl ding a, bawngtaltuai ah ephah khat, belamtal ah ephah khat, belamnou pen ah atheih bangbang leh ephah khat zel ah sathau hin khat ahi ding hi.
Vaihawmpa alut chiang in kongpi sumtawng ah alut ding a, huai mah ah apawtkhe nawn ding hi.

Vantangte bel ankuanglui ni sehsa a TOUPA ma a ahong pai uleh Pathian be ding a mallam kongpi a hong lut simlam kongpi ah apawtkhe ding ua; simlam kongpi a hong lut mallam kongpi ah apawtkhe leuleu ding uh; alutna kongpi uah akik ding uh ahi kei a, amalam uah apai zaw ding uh ahi.
Huan alut chiang un alak uah vaihawmpa alut ding a, apawt chiang un apawtkhe nawn ding hi.
Nopbawlna leh sehsa ankuanglui nite, tanghou lat bawngtaltuai khat ah ephah khat, belamtal khat ah ephah khat, belamnou pen ah apiak theih bangbang, ephah khat ah sathau hin khat zel ahi ding hi.

Huan vaihawmpa'n ut thu a thillat alat dekleh halmang kithoihna hiam lemna thillat hiam TOUPA kiang a ut thu a athillat bang a alat dekleh suahlam nga kong ahonsak ding a, Sabbath ni a hih bangmah in, halmang kithoihnate leh lemna thillatte abawl ding; huchi in apawtkhe ding a, apawtkhiak nung in kong akhak ding uhi.
"Niteng a TOUPA kiang a halmang kithoihna ding in belamnou kum khat a upa, gensiatbei na zang ding a, zingsang in na zat ding ahi.
heading: Niteng Thillat

paite: Zingsang teng in tanghou lat na bawl ding a, ephah seh guk a khen seh khat leh sathau hin khat seh thum a khen seh khat tangbuang nel mahmah anomsakna ding; huai tuh tangtawn a TOUPA kiang a tanghou latdan ding ahi.
Hichibang in halmang thillat gige ding in belamnou, tanghou latte, sathaute zingsang teng in na bawl ding ahi," chi in.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Vaihawmpa'n atapate, kua kiang ah leng, goutan bangpeuh apiakleh atapate a ahi ding a, agou uh luah ahi mai hi.
heading: Kumpi Tapa Leh Gam

paite: Himahleh agoutan a pen anasemmi kuahiam kiang a apiakleh sal pawtna kum tan in anei ding a, huai ah vaihawmpa kiang ah apekik nawn ding hi. Amah gou ngeingei bel atapate a ding ahi ding.

Huai lou in vaihawmpa in mite goutan asuhsak ding ahi kei a, aneih-le-lam ua kipan adelhkhe ding ahi sam kei; amah a pen mah atapate kiang ah goutan in ape ding a; amau neih-le-lam a kipan mite avakzaklouhna ding un," achi hi.
Huan kongpi pang a siampute a dia dantan siangthou mallam nga ah ahon pilut a; ngai dih, aphaitam tumlam pang ah mun ana om hi.
heading: Tempul Anhuan Innte

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai siampute'n moh ziak a thillat leh khelh ziak a thillat ahuanna mun uh, tanghou lat omna mun ahi; huangsung ponungzaw a atawikhiak ua mite hihsianna dia abawllouhna ding un," achi hi.
Huang ponungzaw ah ahon pikhia a, huangsung ningzul ah ahon paisak a; ngai dih, ahuangsung ning chiat ah huang ana om nawn hi.
Huangsung ning li ah huang, bang nei, adung tong sawmli, avai tong sawmthum ana om a; huai aning ate ali un akikim vek uhi.
Huai mun li sunglam ah akimvel in suang vual in alem ua, huai vual nuai ah akim in huanna ding thuk a-om hi.
Huchi in ka kiang ah, "Hiai an huanna innte ahi, tempul nasem mite'n mite kithoihna sa ahuanna dingte uh," achi hi.
